headline: Coalition sweeps Victoria as Labor era ends; U.S. disables another Iran blockade runner; Lyon axed

us.headline: East Coast cleans up after Thanksgiving storm
us.summary: More than 600,000 customers were still without power Friday morning, down from over 900,000 a day earlier, after storms forced water rescues from New York to Virginia, including 39 people in Norfolk.

us.headline: Black Friday shoppers return as record holiday spending forecast
us.summary: The National Retail Federation expects November-December sales to grow 4.1% to about $1.01 trillion, and Adobe put online spending for Nov. 1-22 at $82.5 billion, up 9.1%.

us.headline: Protesters march in San Juan over Puerto Rico's living standards
us.summary: Demonstrators took to the streets of Puerto Rico's capital over a deteriorating standard of living.

us.headline: Melania Trump and LSU launch scholarships for former foster youth
us.summary: The first lady and Louisiana State University announced a scholarship program for students who spent time in foster care.

australia.headline: Jess Wilson to become Victoria's 51st premier
australia.summary: The Coalition ended 12 years of Labor government in a landslide, and Premier Ben Carroll conceded after losing his own seat of Niddrie.

australia.headline: One Nation outpolls Labor in Victorian primary vote
australia.summary: Early counting put the Coalition near 34% of the primary vote, One Nation about 23.5%, the Greens 15.9% and Labor 15.6%.

australia.headline: PNG to sell power stations Australia paid to upgrade
australia.summary: Papua New Guinea will tender 18 regional PNG Power centres, six of which were earmarked for $25 million in Australian-funded upgrades, citing financial pressure.

ai.headline: OpenAI reportedly countersues Apple over trade secrets
ai.summary: OpenAI has filed a countersuit accusing Apple of stealing trade secrets, according to a Financial Times report.

ai.headline: SAP reportedly plans at least 10,000 job cuts in AI push
ai.summary: The German software maker is reported to be cutting at least 10,000 jobs as part of an AI-focused restructuring.

ai.headline: AI boom steers recovery in China's factory profits
ai.summary: Chinese industrial profits grew again in October, with AI-related industries among the biggest gainers.

tech.headline: U.S. military says systems secure after reported cloud breach
tech.summary: The military did not say whether the Air Force's Cloud One platform was hacked after reports that a breach found last month could expose sensitive data such as air-defence radar feeds.

tech.headline: Rockstar Games employees vote against unionizing
tech.summary: Workers at the developer of Grand Theft Auto VI rejected a union.

world.headline: U.S. disables another ship trying to breach Iran blockade
world.summary: Central Command said an aircraft struck the stern of the Palau-flagged Pacific Archer in the Gulf of Oman, disabling it without harming the crew; it is at least the 15th vessel disabled since the blockade began.

world.headline: Zelenskyy urges U.S. pressure on Putin
world.summary: Ukraine's president called Trump's description of Putin as a friend strange, drawing a rebuke from the Kremlin, a day after EU leaders failed to agree on a loan for Ukraine.

world.headline: Mexico condemns DEA crime tip line as interference
world.summary: Mexico's government denounced a U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration tip line as foreign interference, while some Mexicans welcomed it.

aus-cricket.headline: Nathan Lyon dropped from Test squad for New Zealand
aus-cricket.summary: Corey Rocchiccioli takes over as the frontline spinner, ending Lyon's 13-year run, with Lyon one of three players left out ahead of the first Test on Dec. 9.

aus-cricket.headline: Cricket Australia to publish Sandpapergate forum findings
aus-cricket.summary: CA said the findings of an independent forum into the 2018 ball-tampering scandal will be made public, after players gave conflicting accounts of who knew of the plan.

warriors.headline: Blazers rout Warriors 116-94, ending NBA Cup run
warriors.summary: Golden State, missing Stephen Curry, was eliminated from the NBA Cup with a 22-point loss in Portland on Friday night.

warriors.headline: Curry to miss next three games, including the Clippers
warriors.summary: Curry, out since tearing an oblique on Nov. 11, will sit at least through Sunday's home game against the LA Clippers and two more after it.
